summary: Replace the stock graphical installer shell with custom Nex UI. API impact: none; local cdebconf presentation using its existing pinned ABI.

guide.reason: The graphical installer now has Nex layout and section indicators; document actual navigation and verification limits.

api.reason: The boot menu selects a local frontend using unchanged Debian question/answer behavior. No Controller operation, Core command/result, or client-facing API is introduced.

verification.method: Build ISO and actual GTK module; compile classifier checks; interact with BIOS/UEFI modes, 800x600 keyboard, password errors and disk-confirmation workflow in disposable QEMU. Inspect screenshots and source archive; limits in QA.
